newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daido Hoxan ask-only after media reports.
newsitem.headline: Daido Hoxan ask-only after media reports.

text.p: Shares of Daido Hoxan Inc were ask-only in early Monday morning trade after media reports about the dismissal of its president and liabilities at Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd, of which it is the top shareholder.
Shares of industrial gas producer Daido Hoxan were ask-only at 405 yen at 0144 GMT, after closing at 435 yen on Friday.
Daido Hoxan on Monday confirmed that its president, Shigeru Mizushima, was dismissed at an extraordinary board meeting.

The move came after Mizushima filed a complaint with prosecutors accusing Aoki and company vice president Takashi Ito of breach of trust, the company said. It added that the two men had denied the accusations.

The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Monday that Tateho's unit in the United States was facing business difficulties and Tateho was suffering from liabililies exceeding its assets due to the U.S. unit's problem.
Daido Hoxan has a 12.4 percent stake in Tateho.
The OSE said earlier on Monday it would suspend trading of Tateho for the rest of the session.
Tateho said it would hold a news conference in the afternoon regarding the newspaper report.
